text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa's debut race is today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right. Who do you think's favored to
win?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, you can't pick me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're not entirely wrong though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She smiles wryly. It's the same smile she
showed
when we arrived at the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was forwarding her info on the other

Umamusume scheduled to run.

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, that one singer is racing today,
right? We've
got to get a photo of... oh!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Get the camera! There's another runner
here. The
one with the hat!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
That's the "Nakayama Festa" kid who
was stirring
up trouble.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Murmur...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
This is her first official race. I wonder
how her
career will unfold from here.

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Round Glasses
text_block_list.text: If she's really got her eyes set on the world stage, the debut shouldn't too hard for her... right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even the favorite. They're just
after the
rumors and sensation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad I've got attention, and not
just from
the reporters.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Apparently that's the girl who
challenged El...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's never raced on an official track
before,
right? This should be interesting.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there. It's only my debut, and
everyone's
already zeroed in on me.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I've got goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pre-race atmosphere is tense as
Nakayama
Festa draws the attention of
the other racers.
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's what this is about...)
(I see, so that's how it is...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, your phone's going off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a calendar notification reminding me
to
rendezvous at the spectator seating
near Gate
10.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Quit freaking out over every little thing.
You're
going to paint a nasty picture if
you can't look
confident.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one heading into the paddock
now, not
you. You can loiter around or
do whatever you
want.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever you say.
choice_data_list: I'm keeping a close eye on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Nakayama Festa off, I make
my way
to the meeting place.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize. I wasn't waiting long at
all!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry! Did I keep you waiting?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The woman I'm meeting is Nakayama
Festa's old
homeroom teacher, and I
happen to owe her a
few favors.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
By the way, did Festa's old video
footage prove
useful to you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
For now, here's her running at the
freestyle track.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid the only other footage I have
is from
when she was little, training at
my father's racing
school.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She made copies of Nakayama Festa's
old racing
videos for me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm so glad!
choice_data_list: It's been a huge help for my research!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's been years since I've visited a
racetrack... it
feels quite refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's go!
choice_data_list: Let's go watch Nakayama Festa right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us move to a spot
where we
can see the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Nakayama Festa should be making an

appearance soon. I'd better notify the
office.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that just now? Sounds like
she's
even caught the attention of the
reporters!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Is that supposed to be a bad thing? No
matter
the reason, eyes are on her. This
is a chance to
show them her real
strength!
choice_data_list: It's not so much attention as curiosity, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You signed the trainer contract with
Festa
because you recognized her true
potential, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I see. Well... I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! That's Festa over there!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... She's really doing it. She's
entered
Tracen Academy, and now she's
making it into the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how she's going to do out
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stand beside Nakayama Festa's mentor.
She
appears moved by how much her
former student
has grown. We look
down at the track below.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This debut will be Nakayama Festa's first
step
towards the global stage. I've got
to figure out
what direction her next
steps should take...
